$comment: Inputs for tools/season_from_research.py: maps the 2012 entrants to pack teams, colours and tracks. Rules, car profiles, engines and tyres come from the era base (bases/dtm-era4/gen.json); 2012 differs only in what is set here and in patches/regulations.json and data/tyremodel.json (no DRS, one dry tyre). Colours and sponsors are read from Pappydhorn12's 2012 drawings.
title: DTM 2012 - Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters

entrants: BMW Team RMG [Reinhold Motorsport / Team RMG]
BMW Team RMG.history: Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach. New to the DTM in 2012. Martin Tomczyk won the 2011 title and moves to BMW with the number 1.

entrants: Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline [Abt Sportsline]
Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline.history: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000. Mattias Ekström won the title with the team in 2004 and 2007.

AMG-Mercedes.history: Run by HWA AG from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. One of two HWA teams in 2012.

BMW Team Schnitzer.history: Based in Freilassing. Has raced BMWs since the 1960s. Back in the DTM with BMW in 2012.

Audi Sport Team Phoenix.history: Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.

Thomas Sabo AMG-Mercedes.history: The second HWA AG team, entered as Thomas Sabo/Mercedes-Benz Bank AMG-Mercedes. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title.

BMW Team RBM.history: Founded by Bart Mampaey. Based in Mechelen, Belgium. New to the DTM in 2012.

Audi Sport Team Abt.history: The second Abt Sportsline team, also from Kempten. Rahel Frey and the rookie Adrien Tambay drive.

DHL AMG-Mercedes.history: Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs Mercedes cars. Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard drives for the team.

Audi Sport Team Rosberg.history: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Raced Mercedes from 2000 to 2004 and Audi since 2006.

Junge Sterne AMG-Mercedes.history: Persson Motorsport runs two Mercedes cars. Entered as Junge Sterne/TV-Spielfilm AMG-Mercedes.

sponsors.$comment: Starting deals from Pappydhorn12's 2012 drawings, primary first: the lower-numbered car's main sponsor, then the team-mate's, then partners on the team's cars. Each sponsor is on one team only (wishlist E12), so Deutsche Post (E-Postbrief on Scheider's Audi and Werner's BMW) goes to Abt Sportsline and the make-wide partners are spread. Checked against period photos (research/spotter_guide.csv): auto TEST (Scheider's bonnet) added to Abt Sportsline, Samsung (Hand's bonnet and wing) to RMG in place of Allgeier, which ran on every BMW. The manufacturers' own campaigns (Audi ultra, Audi Sport performance cars, BMW M, AMG) and the series partners (DEKRA, ADAC, Hankook, Bosch) are left out.

track_overrides.$comment: 2012 race distances (research/calendar.csv) where they differ from the base's 2013 ones. Hockenheim keeps 42 laps (the finale); the opener ran 40. speed_mult fits the 2012 poles (research/results) from simulated seasons; 2012 cars were mostly 1-3% slower than 2013's. The Norisring includes the base's 1.29. tyre_wear_mult replaces the base's, which was tuned for 2013's soft-plus-hard stints: with one dry tyre these values make two stops the normal strategy.

juniors.$comment: Feeder series from research/juniors/<id>_*.csv (tools/season_from_research.py juniors()). The game runs one race per series and week, so a weekend counts as one race. skill_range and quality_range set the ratings from the 2012 points; licence_start gives the starting licence points (x share of the champion's points).

free_agents.$comment: Hand-rated free agents from research/juniors/free_agents.csv (DTM skills run 11-18): drivers without a 2012 race seat. Kept few: the game favours free agents.

series.name: Formula 3 Euro Series
series.description: The European Formula 3 series. Dallara cars with Mercedes, Volkswagen and other engines. It races at DTM weekends, and several DTM drivers came from here.

series.name: Porsche Carrera Cup Deutschland
series.description: A one-make cup with the Porsche 911 GT3 Cup. It races at DTM weekends. Young professionals race here on their way to GT and touring car seats.

series.name: ATS Formel 3 Cup
series.description: The German Formula 3 championship. Smaller teams and a Trophy class for older cars. It races at ADAC GT Masters and other German weekends.

series.name: ADAC Formel Masters
series.description: A single-seater series for teenagers stepping up from karting. All drivers use the same Dallara car with a Volkswagen engine. It races at ADAC GT Masters weekends.

series.name: ADAC Procar Series
series.description: The ADAC Procar series for production-based touring cars. Super 2000 and Super 1600 cars race in two divisions at ADAC GT Masters weekends. 2012 brought back the Deutsche Tourenwagen Challenge title.
